question: In May 2023, Ravneet Kaur was in the news due to her appointment as the ________.

options.text: Chairperson of Competition Commission of India

solution:
The correct answer is** ​__Chairperson of Competition Commission of India__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Competition Commission of India:

__
 
• The Competition Commission of India (CCI) is a statutory body of the Government of India.
 
• It is responsible for enforcing the Competition Act, 2002 (as amended by the Competition (Amendment) Act, 2007) throughout India.
 
• Objectives:
 
 
• To ensure freedom of trade.
 
• To protect the interests of consumers.
 
• To promote and sustain competition in markets.
 
• To prevent practices that harm the competition.
 
 
 
• Members:
 
 
• The members of the CCI are appointed by the Central Government.
 
• The Competition Commission of India is currently functional with a Chairperson and 6 members.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chief Election Commissioner of India

 
 
• The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering Union and State election processes in India.
 
• According to article 124(2) of the Indian constitution, the Election Commission shall consist of the Chief Election Commissioner and a such number of other Election Commissioners, if any, as the President may from time to time fix and the appointment of the Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners shall, subject to the provisions of any law made in that behalf by Parliament, be made by the President.
